hypotheses.question: Does entry-7 subject GS-P5 represent GS-P1?
for: GS-C2 and GS-C6 share a name/place and approximately compatible birth period.
GS-C3 and GS-C7 share the mother's given name Elin.
against: GS-C5 records an accepted year of 1880, while GS-C6 reports 1879 for the candidate.
No independent record links GS-P1 to Elin Voss, Tomas Vale or 14 Mill Road.
GS-S6 is unavailable, so the transcription cannot be checked against the original.
hypotheses.dependence: GS-S5 copies the register represented by GS-S4. The basis of the unseen GS-S3 online tree is unknown; it cannot be counted as independent corroboration.
hypotheses.conclusion: A plausible lead, not established identity. Keep GS-P1/GS-P5, GS-P3/GS-P6 and GS-P4/GS-P7 separate as working records.
hypotheses.resolving_evidence: A record independently tied to GS-P1 naming parents or an address, compared with entry 7; the original entry-7 scan to check its reading.
